role: Base class for all hostile mobs: registers attackDamage, implements the touch-of-death melee with enchantment knockback, the light-gated spawn rule, and the peaceful-difficulty despawn.

members.name: EntityMob

members.name: onUpdate
members.note: the PEACEFUL setDead after super.onUpdate: living_on_update's EntityMob step, living_is_entity_mob and living_server_peaceful (peaceful-s1, diff-switch-s1)

members.name: findPlayerToAttack

notes: Every hostile subclass file (hostiles_*.c, slimes.c, ghasts.c) rides these shared steps. hostiles.c:hostile_spawn is the natural-spawn driver and hostile_loot_update the drop dispatch that the per-kind dropFewItems plug into. lane/reloadstate: a shooterless arrow's hit makes the arrow entityToAttack; it died hitting, so the mob keeps entity_to_attack 0 with entity_to_attack_gone set, and the old-AI updates (spider, pigman, silverfish, blaze) clear it on their next tick instead of finding a player.
